Existing freshness guards additionally protect errors/pending/retry. No actual database is fetched.

evidence.claim: Private successor restores250ms host debounce, name/email search, accepted server sorting, total and paging.

evidence.claim: Current private server host discards obsolete loads and exposes pending search/page state.

anchors: obsolete settlement cannot clear a newer pending request or replace its committed error
